summary: Smartbird, Inc. (f/k/a Allbirds, Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Dr. Nadia Carlsten as President, CEO, Secretary, and Class I director, effective June 18, 2026, following board approval on June 12, 2026. The filing also disclosed a First Amendment to an existing Securities Purchase Agreement, increasing senior secured convertible notes issuance by $50M to an aggregate $100M principal, with a conversion price of $4.00 for the incremental notes. No departure of a prior CEO was detailed, but the abrupt CEO change is the primary event. No advisor or board recommendation regarding the notes was provided. Watch for further executive turnover or strategic shifts, and monitor conversion mechanics and potential dilution. The 8-K combines a management change with a financing amendment—the CEO appointment is the non-routine event.
